column1: # Every feature suggestion and hypothesis this project has put through the
# bar, and what happened to it. Typed by hand like the patch log is; read
# by scripts/board.py for the README and scripts/webapp.py for the app, so
# one edit here updates both surfaces and they cannot disagree.
# The status is a verdict, not a mood:
#   green    verified and helping — cleared two separate time windows and
#            is live in the engine today
#   orange   unfinished — measured but not concluded, or shipped on
#            PROBATION and still waiting on live results to confirm it
#   red      declined — tested and rejected, with the number that killed
#            it. These are kept deliberately: a dead idea that stays
#            written down does not get re-proposed every fortnight.
# Columns: status, date, area, hypothesis, verdict.

column4: The weakest leagues can be lifted the way the cups were — but only under an ROI constraint
column5: Raised floors climb selection to safer rungs and lift hitrate in both windows everywhere — but the first pass measured only hitrate, and GRE-SL's 80.9 → 91.7 turned out to cost 66% → 6% of PLAYABLE volume (buy≥ 1.37 → 1.19): safe rungs nobody can buy edge on. Final rule: highest floor keeping ≥2/3 of playable volume. Six leagues ship 0.82, one 0.80, seven 0.78; GRE-SL and PER-L1 revert; MLS (worse at any floor) and ITA-SB (nothing to climb to) never shipped

column4: Above says 90% the domestic board is too sure of itself
column5: Measured on 32,493 tips across 45 leagues: below 90% the gap is −0.2 (honest); at 90%+ it is −1.2 ± 0.3, holds in both windows (−1.0 / −1.5) and is STRONGER in the played population (−1.8 / −1.4). Flat inside the band, so HIGH_SAYS_DEBIT 0.012 ships on the published number — selection stays raw

column4: Per-league gaps at n=200 are mostly noise wearing a number
column5: The worst sixteen rows, re-measured at ~780 each: ROU-L1 −11.6 → −2.8, and every one of them collapsed into a band of −2.8 to +1.7 around a pooled −1.7. One row in the whole table cleared two standard errors. The table now replays up to 800 fixtures capped at two seasons

column4: One update is never one match
column5: The sweep checks every unsettled fixture against ESPN, grades on the 90 with extra time peeled off, and refuses to leave neighbours stale — the human failure it replaces was updating one score and leaving three settled bets showing as open

column4: ESPN files by the competition's local day
column5: A Chilean 18:00 sits on our previous date, so the sweep asked for one day and was told nothing was there; neighbouring days are now merged, which covers the Americas below us and Asia above

column4: Club identity across sources
column5: NFD leaves ø, đ, ł and ß whole (Lillestrøm was not Lillestrom), and a translated name shares no letters with its original (Red Star Belgrade is Crvena zvezda) — folded and aliased through the nickname file

column4: The +1% edge bar separates rather than thins
column5: This run's settled Tip 1: 75.0% held (says 82.7, gap −7.7) · 86.7% at +1–3% · 100% at +3%+. The withheld band is the only one grading BELOW its own stated probability

column4: The renderer must verify itself
column5: Every fixture on every surface, tallies matching, ledger complete, generated script parsing — a mismatch refuses to finish. Written after a syntax error blanked every page while the file still looked fine

column4: A live lane should say what the score did to it
column5: Landed, needs N more, room for N, half gone — read from the ledger's own settlement so a push is never called a loss

column4: The cup mu is blind to WHICH side is strong
column5: It priced from |elo gap|, symmetric, so a strong home side and a strong away side got the same number. B3 is the strongest term the cup lane has produced (t 4.95) and improves both windows live: 83.3 → 84.3

column4: Cup over-tips are systematically hot
column5: Measured 3.5 points hot in both seasons and flat across bands, so a flat debit is the right shape — OVER_SAYS_DEBIT ships, windows close at +0.0 / −0.1

column4: Hitrate-first selection beats edge-first on cups
column5: A probability floor of 0.82 on all six cup codes lifts ~80 → ~83 at zero volume cost

column4: A cashed-out position settles at cashout, not at the result
column5: The column existed and was not being read; a position cashed at stake settles 1.00x immediately

column4: Rule 5, DNB confluence
column5: Backtested on 6,354 pointed pairs: the pointed-team lane is real at 78%, and the home+strong rung avoids defeat 83.9% — leg 4 stops being judgement and becomes a number

column4: Rule 6, the line-translation ladder
column5: Softer line first, printed line second, harder half-line only at buy≥ +0.07–0.10

column4: Team lanes should see the opponent's defense
column5: DEFENSE_BLEND 0.5 — worth +7 to +11 points on team lanes

column4: Top-six clashes are priced too high
column5: BIG_MATCH_DEBIT 0.15 goals, validated on both windows

column4: A league can be launched same-day
column5: NED-D2 taken from check data → calibrate → futurematch in one sitting, and went 4-for-4 on its first slate

column4: A promoted club can be priced from its lower-division history
column5: Cross-division fallback at measured exchange rates (×0.754 scored, ×1.516 conceded), validated on 608 historical tips

column4: The published buy≥ thresholds were all too low
column5: Re-derived from settlement rather than from stated probability, with the winner's-curse haircut folded into buy_from — hand rules became code

column4: The team lane was split by venue and four checks missed it
column5: Found and fixed; the "side split" it appeared to leave behind was then measured and is not real

column4: mu is over-spread
column5: The founding recalibration: MU_SHRINK to 0.60 with the floor moved to match, the single largest accuracy change the engine has had

column4: The weakest sides are rated too low
column5: TEAM_RATE_FLOOR 0.95

column4: TUR-SL and ESP-L2 are overconfident in their RECENT two seasons
column5: The only two rows that survive the noise-aware re-measure: TUR-SL −5.2 (n 391), ESP-L2 −4.3 (n 525) — both read fine over a longer trail (−2.6 / −2.8 at n≈740), so the miss is concentrated in the current window. Cause not yet diagnosed

column4: IRL-PD and MAR-BP price on a mu that carries no information
column5: At n≈800 IRL-PD's residual slope is −2.8 (t −3.0) and NEGATIVE IN BOTH WINDOWS — mu is anti-correlated with outcomes there; MAR-BP reads −0.8 (t −2.2). Their hitrates survive because the league mean carries them, but the stated probabilities pretend knowledge. Cull candidates, decision pending

column4: The whole Club Elo cup lane
column5: PROBATIONARY. 92% coverage, all windows same-signed, a 202-fixture dress rehearsal at 89.1% and a pooled gap of +0.1 after B3 — but cups have failed this project twice before, so it stays labelled until a full slate of live results confirms it

column4: Level-aggregate second legs are decided at home, not through goals
column5: Profiled on 645 ties: goals ordinary (2.74 v 2.67 usual) but the home side wins 49.1% and 21.7% go to extra time. Real, and printed as context beside the tip — it is not yet a term in the mu

column4: First-leg caution has faded
column5: Second legs run 2.81 goals against first legs' 2.59 and hold both windows, but the caution effect is gone (older −0.19, t −4.28; newer +0.02). Recorded, not acted on

column4: The big-match effect has a season-phase structure
column5: The structure is real and measured; no constant has been cut from it yet

column4: UEFA country coefficients as a cup strength source
column5: Proposed and never measured — Club Elo was taken instead because it prices CLUBS directly rather than their federations. Still open if the Elo lane fails probation

column4: ALG-L1 has no ESPN coverage
column5: Every slug returns 400, so Algerian fixtures cannot be swept and must be graded by hand. No second provider wired in yet

column4: Domestic context: the mismatch term
column5: The fourth "signal without edge" in a day. Clears the residual bar outright (+0.241 ± 0.063, t 3.81, both windows) and still LOSES hitrate when converted to tips: 86.4 → 85.9 and 86.4 → 85.7

column4: Domestic context: league table position
column5: +0.103 ± 0.035, t 2.94 — but windows t 2.42 / 1.75, one window short

column4: Domestic context: three-season stature
column5: Barcelona is always top three as a number. t 2.06 pooled, windows 1.17 / 1.79 — fails the bar

column4: Domestic context: which side is better (signed PPG)
column5: The domestic echo of the cup fix. t 2.40 pooled, windows 1.92 / 1.46 — the hole B3 filled in cups does not exist here, because domestic mu is already built from each side's own rate at its own venue

column4: Domestic context: the reverse fixture
column5: t 1.32. Nothing

column4: MU_SHRINK is over-correcting the extremes
column5: Refuted directly. If it were, the residual would concentrate where mu sits far from the league mean; instead it is strongest in the MIDDLE (near +0.116, middling +0.358, far +0.251)

column4: The aggregate score should move the mu
column5: The apparent lead effect was the strength gap that created the lead — against the engine's own mu the aggregate adds nothing (t ≈ 1)

column4: First and second legs should be priced differently
column5: Profiled across 5,341 legs. Against the engine's own mu neither leg is detectable, so no leg term

column4: Elo plus domestic form
column5: Goal-tempo terms carry real signal (t 2.6, 2.1) but no window improves when graded; results-based form and Elo momentum are flat outright

column4: A Swiss-era club composite
column5: The closest any pre-Elo cup model came, and still short: −0.6 / −4.0

column4: League bridge ratings
column5: Real ratings, genuinely informative, and one window short — the recurring cup failure signature

column4: Domestic form carries cup signal
column5: Slope 0.017. Zero

column4: The pointed gate can rescue cups
column5: It helps in BOTH directions (+0.7 vs −2.3 forward, −3.4 vs −4.6 reverse) and still fails, because the reverse window's miss is a LEVEL error and no selection rule fixes a mis-levelled mu

column4: Tightening cup EDGE improves cup tips
column5: It hurts — the winner's curse. High printed edge often means the mu is wrong, not that the price is generous. Tightening PROBABILITY is what worked

column4: The O0.5 tag on a pointed team
column5: The trap in Rule 5: it looks like the safest rung on the board and grades worst

column4: VENUE_BLEND is a live knob
column5: Swept for the first time and closed: dead at 0.35

column4: Defense belongs in the MATCH mu too
column5: ~+1 point, and it double-counts what the rates already carry

column4: Season restart is an effect of its own
column5: It was a symptom of the over-spread mu; once MU_SHRINK landed, it disappeared

column4: The rung defect is a Poisson shape error
column5: The sixth hypothesis for that defect, and dead like the five before it

column4: The freshness gate should be made binding
column5: Staleness costs about a point; making the gate binding costs more than that in withheld fixtures

column4: A relegation variant of the big-match debit
column5: Measured alongside the top-six version and declined

column4: The cup family as originally built
column5: Measured at −11.4 and taken off the board entirely — the failure that started the whole cup investigation
